During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''temple''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It served as the site for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Funeral of Cei Vookto|funeral]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cei Vookto]], who sacrificed his life in the [[Battle of Lianna]].
